title: The Mortuary Lock Code
description: Scratched into the brass dial of the iron gate are numbers. Determine the missing final digit to unlock the passage.
hints: Examine the ratio between consecutive numbers.

title: The Caretaker's Rotated Scribble
description: A bloody diary page has the word 'RUN' written in Caesar cipher (shifted forward by 3 letters: R->U, U->X, N->Q = UXQ). Decode this warning found on the wall: 'KHOOR'. What does it say?
rule: Caesar cipher with shift 3 (subtract 3 positions in the alphabet: K->H, H->E, O->L, O->L, R->O).
hints: Shift each letter backward in the alphabet by 3 positions.
K minus 3 is H. H minus 3 is E.

title: The Toll of the Cursed Bells
description: The cathedral bells toll at strange intervals: 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, ?. What is the next bell count?
hints: These are not merely odd numbers; notice 2 is included.
Numbers only divisible by 1 and themselves.

title: The Three Haunted Statues
description:
Three statues stand before the crypt: Jack (Jester), Crow (Raven), and Grim (Reaper). Only ONE statue tells the truth; the other two always lie.
- Jester says: 'The key is inside the Reaper.'
- Raven says: 'I do not have the key.'
- Reaper says: 'The Jester is lying.'
Who holds the key: JESTER, RAVEN, or REAPER?
rule: If Jester tells truth -> Reaper lies, but Raven's statement 'I don't have it' would mean Raven lies so Raven DOES have it, contradicting Jester. If Reaper tells truth -> Jester lies (key not in Reaper). Raven lies -> Raven DOES have the key! Thus Raven holds the key and Reaper is the sole truth-teller.
hints: Assume each statue tells the truth one by one and test for contradictions.
Notice the conflict between Jester and Reaper.
If Reaper tells the truth, Raven's denial must be a lie.

title: The Alchemist's Pentagram Code
description: An alchemical formula reads: S-U-L-P-H-U-R = 7, B-L-O-O-D = 5, S-E-W-E-R = 5. A lock requires the value of N-I-G-H-T-M-A-R-E. What number turns the tumbler?
formula: Count the number of distinct letters: N, I, G, H, T, M, A, R, E
rule: The count of letters in the horror word.
hints: Count the letters in SULPHUR (7), BLOOD (5), SEWER (5).
Apply the same logic to NIGHTMARE.
